surprises.title: Shutoff valve seizes
surprises.description: Oh no! The shutoff under the sink won't budge, and now it's dripping down your wrist.

options.text: Repipe the whole kitchen
Shut off the main and replace the shutoff
Crank harder with a pipe wrench

surprises.title: Main valve fails
surprises.description: Main closed, water still trickling. The valve has given up on life.

options.text: Replace every valve in the house
Call the utility to shut off the street
Work fast with a bucket and hope

surprises.title: Mounting nuts seize
surprises.description: The nuts are rusted solid. You're upside down, flashlight in your mouth.

options.text: Cut it out with an oscillating tool
Pull the whole sink out of the countertop
Use penetrating oil and a basin wrench

surprises.title: Supply line cracks
surprises.description: Yikes! The old supply line snaps the moment you bend it.

options.text: Reuse the old line very gently
Install new braided supply lines
Wrap it in duct tape

surprises.title: Faucet holes don't match
surprises.description: Surprise! Your new faucet needs one hole. Your sink has three.

options.text: Replace the sink and countertop
Cover the extra holes with a deck plate
Fill the extra holes with caulk

surprises.title: Cabinet floor rots
surprises.description: Squish. The cabinet floor is soft and smells like a swamp.

options.text: Lay a plastic mat over it
Remodel the whole kitchen
Cut out and replace the cabinet floor

surprises.title: New sink doesn't fit
surprises.description: The new sink is one inch too wide for the countertop cutout. Of course it is.

options.text: Return it for a sink that fits
Force it in with a rubber mallet
Replace the countertop

surprises.title: Backsplash looks dated
surprises.description: Hmm. Next to your shiny new faucet, the backsplash looks straight out of 1987.

options.text: Retile the backsplash this weekend
Paint over the tile with wall paint
Add it to the someday list

surprises.title: Partner requests bulb change
surprises.description: Your partner calls from the hallway: "While you're at it, can you change this bulb?"

options.text: Leave the sink in pieces and do it now
Smart lights in every room
Change it once the faucet is done

surprises.title: Pipe stub is too short
surprises.description: You cut off the old valve, and now there's barely half an inch of pipe left to grab.

options.text: Use a push-fit valve made for short stubs
Open the wall and repipe the run
Solder on a pipe extension

surprises.title: Water utility is delayed
surprises.description: The water utility can shut off the street valve... on Monday. It's Friday night.

options.text: Turn the street valve with a broom
Cap the sink lines and wait until Monday
Pay a plumber to freeze the pipe

surprises.title: Blade nicks the sink
surprises.description: The oscillating tool slips. There's now a shiny scratch across your stainless sink.

options.text: Color it in with a silver marker
Replace the sink
Buff it out with a scratch repair kit

surprises.title: Fittings don't fit
surprises.description: New lines: 3/8 inch. Your valves: 1/2 inch. The store closes in 20 minutes.

options.text: Wrap the threads in tape until it holds
Grab the right adapters before close
Buy one of every fitting in the aisle

surprises.title: Countertop chips
surprises.description: Crack! A chunk of laminate pops off while you're widening the cutout.

options.text: Replace the entire countertop
Superglue the chip back on
Fill it with a color-matched repair kit

surprises.title: Mold hides under cabinet
surprises.description: Under the rotten floor: fuzzy black spots. Mold moved in and stopped paying rent.

options.text: Gut the kitchen to the studs
Clean, dry, and treat the area
Paint right over it

surprises.title: Disposal starts groaning
surprises.description: The garbage disposal just made a noise like a dying walrus.

options.text: Install a commercial-grade disposal today
Pour drain cleaner in it and run it
Note it and finish the faucet first

ask.question: How do I replace a kitchen faucet?
ask.answer: Easy! 1. Unscrew the old one. 2. Screw in the new one. 3. Enjoy!
ask.skipped: It skipped shutting off the water and the supply lines.
